results.name: sign in with an account, see the team and its project list
open the team and create a project
add freeform nodes on the canvas (double-click)
give each node a title (Gate, Door, Cellar)
choose a node header colour
pan the canvas by dragging empty space
drag a node and it stays where it is dropped
connect nodes with choices (Gate to Door, Door to Cellar)
Start, End and Unreachable markers
make another node the start node, then back
undo and redo a change
copy and paste a node
select several nodes at once
minimap shows and hides
header search jumps to a node by title
write script lines with a character name
add an A/V cue and a lighting cue
upload an image and audio file; both play or show in the panel
a file that is not what its name says is refused
add a link to a video (video upload is off)
add chapters as tabs, rename one, switch between them
link a node to a node in another chapter (cross-chapter tag)
close a chapter tab and reopen it from the list
move a node to the trash and restore it
Player Mode: start, choose, chapter name, back, restart, history
export the map as PDF, Word, JPG and PNG
light and dark theme toggle
offline: edit, see the waiting count, reconnect, change is saved
export and import the project file (JSON)
share: make a view link and a comment link
a view link opens without an account, read-only, and can be played
